Implemented ethers v6 compatibility without modifying tests or manifests.

Key changes:
- Added [ethers compat layer](/app/packages/shared/src/ethers.ts) for removed v5 APIs used by source/tests: `BigNumber`, `utils`, `providers`, `ContractReceipt`-style types, base58 helpers.
- Repointed shared/generated ABI source and handwritten source imports to the compat layer.
- Preserved v5-style `contract.address` on v6 `Contract` instances from generated factories.
- Added bigint-safe amount handling for v6 contract read results.
- Added `tsconfig` mapping so unchanged tests importing `ethers` resolve the compat surface.

Verification:
- `pnpm --filter sdk-shared lint`
- `pnpm --filter sdk-shared build`
- `pnpm --filter sdk-shared typecheck && pnpm --filter sdk typecheck && pnpm --filter cli typecheck && pnpm --filter swap typecheck`
- Node 18 Jest: shared, sdk, and cli suites pass.
- Isolated copy with manifests temporarily changed to `ethers@6.7.1`: shared/sdk/cli tests and all package typechecks pass.
